title: dssrf: dssrf: any users using 1.1.1.1 DNS is impacted by SSRF
provenance: Labels come from the maintainers' fix commit, not from a model: the lines it changed or removed in its parent commit (advisory GHSA-5846-7qm3-r52j). Whether the patch really addresses the advisory is recorded in history.label_review.
contamination: Advisory published 2026-07-31 and fix committed 2026-06-09, both on or after 2026-03-10, after the 2026-03-03 release of gemini-3.1-flash-lite (knowledge cutoff January 2025): that model cannot have trained on this fix. A model with a later cutoff might have. The code may still resemble earlier public fixes of similar bugs in the same project.

bugs.title: dssrf: any users using 1.1.1.1 DNS is impacted by SSRF
bugs.notes: Judge a finding against the advisory text in `history`, not only against the lines.
